# Tests that must stay in the workspace: CI fails when one of them is gone.
#
# Manual modelling (#26, #27, #28) was lost from main on 2026-10-22, its
# tests with it, and 0.4.0 shipped without it while its notes listed it
# (restored by #41). A test that disappears fails nothing, so this list
# names the tests of what the app must keep doing: deleting one of them
# means deleting its line here too, on purpose, in the same pull request.
#
# One test per line, as `cargo test -- --list` names it.
